verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes show the ANEF portal serves only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell to a keyless agent, leaving under 200 characters of text. The parent ministry site returns HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare challenge. The public reading surface is therefore not reachable without a JS-only shell or bot wall, so the product fails this applicable axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
